title: Command Pattern
overview: Encapsulate a request as an object, allowing parameterisation, queuing, logging, and undoable operations.
useCases: You want to decouple the object requesting an action from the object performing it
You need to queue, schedule, or log operations
You want to support undo/redo by storing executed commands
You have many actions (menu items, toolbar buttons, keyboard shortcuts) that should all trigger work in a uniform way
